title: HAPwave_bids
description: Intracranial EEG (iEEG) recordings from 8 patients undergoing single pulse electrical stimulation while resting in a hospital bed. The dataset supports investigation of stimulation-driven network interactions in the human limbic system. Data are organized in BIDS with metadata for event timing.
methods_description: Patients rested in the hospital bed while biphasic single pulse electrical stimulation (200 microsecond duration, 6 mA amplitude) was delivered. For subject 7, amplitude was sometimes reduced to 4 mA to minimize interictal responses.
